decisive_items: Cardiac troponin I level was 25 ng/mL (normal, <0.023 ng/mL)
ST-segment elevation in leads III and aVR, Q wave in lead III, and ST-segment depression in leads I, II, aVL, aVF, and V2 to V6
response.rationale: The patient's elevated cardiac troponin I level and specific ECG findings support the diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction, which is further confirmed by coronary angiography showing total occlusion of the right coronary artery and subtotal occlusion of the left main coronary artery.
